title: Worldline Axiom Registry Schema v1
description: Machine-readable schema for the Worldline axiom registry. Covers product axioms (value tier + convention tier) and harness axioms (H tier). Encodes placeholder discipline and waiver discipline as schema constraints. Canopus B2 populates the data file (.harness/axioms-v1.json) conforming to this schema.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes to this schema (new required fields, changed types).

registry_id.description: Registry identifier, e.g. 'axioms-v1'. Monotonically increasing at major registry re-bless.

signed_by.description: The human who signed the product axioms. Harness axioms are ratified by the same human but authored by Canopus.

signed_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the signing event.

axioms.description: Ordered list of axioms. Product axioms (V + C tiers) appear before harness axioms (H tier) by convention.

axiom.description: A single axiom entry. Placeholder discipline: must_project_by is REQUIRED when status is UNPROJECTED or PARTIAL. Missing must_project_by on a non-PROJECTED axiom = schema violation (fail-closed). Waiver discipline: block_until is REQUIRED when status is BLOCKED (held beyond a date-bounded queue).

must_project_by.description: HARD DATE. Must be an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD). A placeholder like '<Peat sets>' is NOT a valid date and will fail schema validation. The absence of a real date on an UNPROJECTED or PARTIAL axiom is fail-closed: it ossifies into permanent amber. Join-coverage audit will RED any UNPROJECTED axiom past this date.

id.description: Axiom identifier. V-prefix = value tier. C-prefix = convention tier. H-prefix = harness tier. Numeric suffix is monotonic within tier.

tier.description: Axiom tier. 'value' = identity-level product commitment (Peat signs; heavy re-bless). 'convention' = arbitrary-but-fixed product commitment (Peat signs; free re-bless). 'harness' = ops-layer commitment (Canopus authors; Peat ratifies, does NOT author).

statement.description: Human-readable axiom statement. Normative — this is the signed commitment.

realizes.description: For convention-tier axioms: the value-tier axiom(s) this convention realizes. Empty array for value-tier axioms and harness axioms. Encodes the 'realizes' relationship from the candidate registry (e.g. C1 realizes V1).

projects_to.description: The gate IDs in worldline-harness.config.json that enforce this axiom. Join-coverage audit requires every PROJECTED axiom to have at least one entry here that exists as a key in the harness config 'rails' object. UNPROJECTED axioms may have an empty array — but join-coverage will RED them past must_project_by.

items.description: A rail key from worldline-harness.config.json (e.g. 'accessibility-floor', 'design-tokens'). Must match a key in config.rails exactly.

owner.description: The agent designation(s) responsible for projecting this axiom into an enforcing gate. For PROJECTED axioms: the agent who built the gate. For UNPROJECTED/PARTIAL: the agent responsible for closing the gap by must_project_by. Free-form string — 'Algol+Canopus' is valid.

signed_by.description: Who signed off on this specific axiom. For product axioms (V/C tier): Peat. For harness axioms (H tier): Canopus (authored) + Peat (ratified). Record the signer — not the author for H-tier.

signed_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this axiom was signed.

status.description: Projection status. PROJECTED = at least one enforcing gate exists and is non-stub. UNPROJECTED = axiom signed but zero enforcing gates. PARTIAL = gate exists but is a stub (passes without verifying — e.g. accessibility-floor). BLOCKED = legitimately held past block_until (requires block_until + blocked_on fields). Join-coverage REDs UNPROJECTED/PARTIAL past must_project_by.

must_project_by.description: Required for UNPROJECTED and PARTIAL status. ISO date by which a real enforcing gate must exist. Past this date with status still UNPROJECTED or PARTIAL = join-coverage RED.

block_until.description: Required for BLOCKED status. ISO date when the block expires. Past block_until with status still BLOCKED = escalation. This is the waiver discipline: a blocked axiom is legitimately held WITHIN the bound; it expires to RED/escalation beyond it.

blocked_on.description: Required when status is BLOCKED. The party or condition that must resolve before projection proceeds. Example: 'Peat-approval' or 'Wave-B-Canopus-gate-wiring'.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes. Does NOT substitute for machine-readable fields. Notes without owner+date are not actionable.
